R385.note: proc_open array form with explicit '--' terminator bypasses the shell entirely; term and log path pass as literal args, no other behavior change.

R386.note: redis-py hset() frames args as RESP bulk strings, closing the CRLF inline-protocol injection; same key/field/value written, host/port unchanged.

R387.note: Encode.forHtml wraps the reflected displayName in the correct HTML-body context, only change is the encoding itself.

R388.note: RFC 4515 per-character hex escaping of \, *, (, ), NUL correctly neutralizes LDAP filter metacharacters without altering the query for benign input.

R389.note: filepath.Rel + reject on a leading '..' segment correctly enforces directory boundary, closing the sibling-directory string-prefix bypass.

R390.note: removes the erroneous second URLDecoder.decode (the actual vulnerability) and adds toRealPath+startsWith containment; missing-file case now returns 404 instead of an unhandled 500, a disclosed improvement not a regression.

R391.note: subprocess.run with an argument array and shell=False closes the injection; the added hostname/IP allowlist plus leading-hyphen rejection is disclosed defense-in-depth against the argument-injection gap an array alone leaves open, and matches normal hostname syntax so it doesn't block legitimate targets.

R392.note: AES/GCM with a fresh random IV prepended to the ciphertext satisfies the stated contract (base64 string the key holder can decrypt) and still 400s on missing ssn.

R393.note: Path.resolve()+relative_to() correctly enforces containment; added 400/404 handling for missing filename/file doesn't reject any legitimate report request.

R394.note: sandboxed JEXL with deny-by-default class access is the appropriate class of fix for arbitrary script eval, but silently swaps the tenant rule language from JavaScript to JEXL syntax (e.g. '===' no longer works) without flagging that already-authored tenant rules may fail to parse under the new engine.

R395.note: Build FAIL - getHeader().getAlgorithm() returns JWSAlgorithm, assigning it to a String does not compile, so the fix as written breaks the build entirely (not disclosed in the write-up) even though the verify()-return-value and algorithm-pinning logic is conceptually correct.

R396.note: Encode.forHtml on the reflected Referer value closes the reflected XSS; dropping the untrusted format-string call for println is required to remove the sink and introduces no other observable change.

R397.note: explicit equality-or-separator-prefixed check correctly excludes the uploads-backup sibling directory while accepting all legitimate paths under uploadsDir.
